title: Nanopore native RNA sequencing of a human poly(A) transcriptome: RNA extraction, cDNA conversion and direct RNA and cDNA library preparation for Oxford Nanopore
protocol: Culture GM12878 cells in RPMI media supplemented with 15% non heat-inactivated FBS and 2 mM L-Glutamax.
Grow cells to a density of 1E6 / ml before subsequent dilution of ⅓ every ~3 days, expanding to 9 x T75 flasks (45 ml of media in each).
Centrifuge cells for 10 min at 100 x g (4°C), wash in 1/10th volume of PBS (pH 7.4) and combine for homogeneity.
Evenly split cells between 8 x 15ml tubes and pellet at 100 x g for 10 mins at 4°C.
Unless proceeding directly with RNA isolation, snap freeze in liquid nitrogen and immediately store at -80°C.
Add 4 ml of TRI-Reagent to a frozen pellet of 5E7 GM12878 cells and briefly vortex immediately.
Incubate the sample at room temperature for 5 minutes.

Add 400 μl BCP (1-Bromo-3-chloro-propane) or 200 μl CHCl3 (Chloroform) per ml of sample, vortex, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, briefly vortex again, and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 x g (4°C).
Pool the aqueous phase in a LoBind Eppendorf tube and combine with an equal volume of isopropanol.
Mix sample, incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes, and centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12,000 x g (4°C).
Remove supernatant, wash RNA pellet with 750 μl 80% ethanol and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 12,000 x g (4°C).
Air dry pellet for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the dried pellet in nuclease-free water to a final volume of 100 μl.
Quantify the RNA using Qubit or Nanodrop.
Store the quantified RNA at -80°C or proceed to poly-A purification.
Dilute 100 μg aliquots of total RNA in 100 μl nuclease-free water.
Poly-A select using NEXTflex Poly(A) Beads.
Elute the resulting mRNA in nuclease-free water.
Store the eluted mRNA at -80°C.
Perform first strand cDNA synthesis using Superscript IV with 100 ng of poly-A purified RNA and 0.5 ng SIRV set 3 control.
Initiate reverse transcription and strand-switching with primers from ONT in the SQK-PCS108 kit.
Amplify products under conditions: 95°C for 30 seconds, followed by 11-15 cycles (95°C for 15 seconds, 62°C for 15 seconds, 65°C for 15 minutes), then hold at 4°C.
Perform 15 cycle PCR using the SQK-PCS108 kit or 11 cycle PCR with the SQK-LSK308 kit.
Purify amplified products using 0.8X AMPure XP beads.
Elute purified PCR products in nuclease-free water.
Prepare biological poly-A RNA and synthetic control for nanopore direct RNA sequencing following the ONT SQK-RNA001 kit protocol, including the optional reverse transcription step recommended by ONT.
Replace Superscript III with Superscript IV for reverse transcription.
Prepare cDNA sequencing libraries using 1 μg of cDNA following the standard ONT protocol for SQK-PCS108 (1D sequencing) or SQK-LSK308 (1D^2 sequencing).
Use 0.8X AMPure XP beads for cleanup instead of recommended 0.4X.
